errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат визуално подредени по размер
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are visually arranged by size, but this is not true. Following the sectors clockwise from the top, the percentages are 14.3%, 33.3%, an unlabelled small percentage, and 47.6%, which is not an ordered sequence.
The description omits the total number of responses (105), which is explicitly stated on the chart under the title.
